verdict.line: You lose if you brawl into her level 2 or level 6 cooldowns, you win if you poke on her Q timer and let the lane go long.

brief.thesis: Yorick's E (Mourning Mist) reaches 700, which out-ranges every piece of Riven's kit except her one-time post-6 Wind Slash — her Q, W, and E all cap at 250-275. The 47.3% head-to-head over 414 games reflects a lane that is even on paper but decided by discipline: respect her two burst windows (level 2 stun-chain, level 6 Blade of the Exile) and the range gap wins the rest of it for you.

theirWindow.when: She lands W (Ki Burst) stun on you
theirWindow.what: Ki Burst stuns on hit, which lets her freely chain all three Broken Wings strikes and empowered Runic Blade autos into you; if you get caught in the stun, trade back only after the third Q hit (the knockback) resolves, since that's the end of her combo, not the start of a second one.

yourWindow.when: Her Q (Broken Wings) is on its 13s cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step up and throw E — at 700 range it lands before she can close with E (Valor) alone, and the armor shred plus slow make the follow-up auto and Q (Last Rites) hit harder; this is the exchange OP.GG's own data flags as your opening.

start.why: Flat physical damage reduction and regen directly counter Riven's auto-reliant Runic Blade trades and her early poke attempts; it's the second most-picked start (40%, 49% WR) for a reason in a lane where she's the one initiating.

boots.why: Reduces incoming damage from her empowered basic attacks (Runic Blade charges), the main source of her sustained trade damage; run away the most-picked boots here at 83.3% pick, 50% WR.

core.why: The proc damage and movement speed let you stick through her E (Valor) dash and convert Q (Last Rites) procs into real trade damage — this path hits 75% WR over its sample.
Cooldown reduction compounds your Q (Last Rites) sustain loop and lets you reset Mist Walker summons faster during extended fights.
Armor penetration plus the slow on-hit punishes her for standing still to land Ki Burst, and keeps your walkers from falling behind on a kiting target.

situational.when: she's ahead and you need burst protection into her level 6 all-in
the game goes long and you need stacking armor shred over a flat slow
the lane stabilizes and you're splitting side lanes uncontested

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp rewards the melee-range trades your Q (Last Rites) already wants to make, and its bonus health directly offsets Riven's burst windows — the highest-picked page here (26.8% pick, 53.9% WR).

summoners.why: This combo runs the highest win rate in the data (53.2%, 30.7% pick) and converts your measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills by denying her sustain during an extended E-range poke war.

playing.title: Poke on her Q cooldown
playing.detail: Throw E (700 range, 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) every time Broken Wings is down; nothing in her remaining kit reaches past 275 to punish you for it.

playing.title: Don't engage at level 2
playing.detail: Her W (Ki Burst) stun unlocks here and chains into a full three-hit Q combo plus empowered autos; hold E range until you have your own E ranked up.

playing.title: Spam Q for free sustain
playing.detail: Last Rites drops to a 4s cooldown by rank 5 — use it on cooldown even on minions to dig graves and keep your Mist Walker count up.

playing.title: Don't wall-trap her with W
playing.detail: Dark Procession is a destructible wall, but her Q and E dashes cross it easily; use it to block the wave or peel rather than expecting it to cut off her escape.

playing.title: Disengage after her level 6
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile gives her bonus AD, range, and a one-time ranged Wind Slash; stay out of melee range while her ult is active and poke with E instead.

playing.title: Mark her before committing walkers
playing.detail: E's mark gives your summoned Mist Walkers bonus move speed toward the marked target, so land E first in any extended trade to let them actually catch her.

playing.title: Play for the mid-game item spike
playing.detail: Trinity Force is your first real power swing — look to force extended trades once it's online rather than in the pre-6 poke phase.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from current-patch (16.19.1) ranked games on OP.GG; the matchup reasoning — why the ranges and cooldowns favor each window — is tactical judgment layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Riven can easily traverse through [W] by using (Q) and (E), giving her the upper hand if you allow her to use all of her skills. Try to use [E] when her (Q) is on cooldown. Do not stand in her range after reaching level 6 and use [E] to poke.
